verdicts.reason: A: the headline breaks into four lines and leaves 'back' alone on the last one. The SOLSTICE wordmark is blown up and sits under the headline, competing with it. The badges are moved below the CTA, so the reading order is wrong, and the background circle is now a stray blob behind 'SUMMER ONLY' at the bottom; there is also dead space at the top. B has the same flaws: the oversized SOLSTICE under the headline, the badges below the CTA and the stray circle. On top of that, its badges are enlarged to the full width of the CTA and 'BACK BY DEMAND' looks like a second button, which flattens the hierarchy. B's headline also runs tight to the right edge and its subcopy shrinks to tiny text, so A is slightly less bad.
